_read_me: Fill this in as facts arrive, then run: node build-toy-drive.mjs. Anything left null or empty renders as an amber [BRACKET] so an unfinished image can't pass for a finished one.
vaa_permission_note: Matthew 6 Nov 2026: 'we have permission to use the VAA Surge and the list of who the donations will benefit'. If VAA's OK is in an email, keep a copy with the campaign.
recipients_confirmed: local families who have reached out or been nominated
recipients_note: Confirmed by Matthew 6 Nov (permission to use the list on the poster). Names as on the poster; the poster's 'Boys & Girls Club of America' is not the national body's exact name (Boys & Girls Clubs of America), so the posts say 'the Boys & Girls Club'.
hours_note: CONFLICT: the poster says 12:00-6:00 pm, the event-locations Google Doc (the poster's QR code) says 11:30 am-6:00 pm. Matthew to say which; one change here updates every image.
events_note: From the Google Doc the poster's QR code opens (read 6 Nov, copy in event-locations-doc-2026-11-06.txt). It gives places and hours but NO dates or days. Add each date when known.
counts_note: Each count must come from the team's dated tally (who counted, when). A figure without a source doesn't go in.
